submitted.rationale: Of the five compositions measured, index 3 (Sb 0.161) had the highest EQE at 0.109%. EQE rose as Sb fell from 0.73 to 0.16 (0.023, 0.048, 0.093, 0.109%), then dropped to 0.049% at Sb 0.127. That puts the peak in the In-rich region, around Sb 0.15–0.26.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.048%, even though Sb 0.51 is close to the InSbO4 composition
EQE 0.023%: the Sb-rich end performs poorly
It lies between measured points at 0.093% and 0.048%, so it is unlikely to beat 0.109%
